summary_for_children: Al-Mutaffifin means Those Who Give Less. It warns traders who cheat on weight and measure.
environment_concept: A morning market stall: a pair of honest scales with brass weights (83:3), and sacks of grain beside an empty wooden measure that can be filled right to the brim (83:2). No person is shown, and the Day, the registers and the next life of 83:4-36 are not pictured.
architecture_and_scenery: A canopied market stall, balance scales with weights, grain sacks and a wooden measure.

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A busy covered market arcade with grain, oil, date and lentil stalls, each with a buying measure and a selling measure

primary_mechanic.text: At five stalls pour the true copper measure into the buying and the selling measure (each fills exactly, overflows or leaves room), then judge the stall honest or "takes in full, gives short" (83:2-3); judging before testing both is refused, and a wrong verdict is noted.

unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading at the gate, testing the stalls, then a reading at the end of the arcade
world_assets: five stalls with two measures each
environment_behaviour: each stall’s two measures are drawn to their real size
a green or red mark shows each verdict
unique_world.learning_objective: Know the warning to those who take in full and give short (83:1-3)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Honest Marketplace
story_library.children_narration: Imagine buying a basket of fruit and discovering that the seller gave you less than you paid for. How would you feel? Surah Al-Mutaffifin warns people who cheat when measuring and weighing goods. It teaches us to treat others fairly.

world_idea.title: The Marketplace of Honesty
world_idea.description: Use working balance scales, fill containers accurately, and solve realistic trade challenges.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
